stemMd: A balance scale has identical blocks on both sides. The left side has 3 blocks and a 200 g weight; the right has 5 blocks. It balances. What is the mass of one block?
explanationMd: Remove three matching blocks from each side. Two blocks remain on the right balancing 200 g on the left. Each block therefore weighs 100 g. Equivalent subtraction preserves balance.

distractorRationale.e: This divides the added weight by all five right-side blocks rather than the excess two.
distractorRationale.c: This assigns the whole added weight to one block.
distractorRationale.b: This divides by the three blocks already balanced on both sides.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies by two instead of dividing.
